# Data Source: okta_collection

Retrieves a resource [Collection](https://developer.okta.com/docs/api/iga/openapi/governance.api/tag/Collections/) by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okta_collection" "example" {
  id = "col1example2AbCdE1d7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the collection.

### Read-Only

- `counts` (Block) Collection count metadata (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--counts)).
- `created` (String) The RFC 3339 date and time when the collection was created.
- `created_by` (String) The `id` of the Okta user who created the collection.
- `description` (String) The human-readable description.
- `last_updated` (String) The RFC 3339 date and time when the collection was last updated.
- `last_updated_by` (String) The `id` of the Okta user who last updated the collection.
- `name` (String) The name of the collection.

<a id="nestedblock--counts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `counts`

Read-Only:

- `principal_assignment_count` (Number) Number of principals the collection is assigned to.
- `resource_count` (Number) The total number of resources in the collection, across all resource types (apps, groups, and push groups).
